title: Worker 84-byte record range transfer
summary: Reconstructs the forward transfer of opaque 84-byte records, including its null-destination check and transfer granularity.
test_description: Compare original and recovered return values and full surrounding buffers for empty, single and multiple records, unaligned, identical and overlapping ranges in both directions; check null destination for zero and one record and FS restoration after each original call.
known_limits: Record field meanings and ownership are unresolved.
Nonempty ranges must terminate by stepping 84 bytes; invalid memory and null destinations beyond one iteration are not tested.
The original uses a custom register-and-stack ABI; the recovered function is a portable adapter, not a binary-compatible entry point.
Overlap behavior is modeled according to the observed 16-byte and 4-byte transfer order; concurrent access and faults are outside scope.
